Product Catalog
features.description: Shoppers can browse a paginated catalog of available products with regional pricing and inventory.

features.name: Category Browsing
features.description: Shoppers can browse products grouped under hierarchical product categories.

features.name: Collection Browsing
features.description: Shoppers can open curated product collections by their public handle.

features.name: Product Search
features.description: Shoppers can search the indexed product catalog from a live search drawer or dedicated results page.

features.name: Catalog Filtering
features.description: Shoppers can refine the catalog by product options, price range, and current sale status.

features.name: Product Sorting
features.description: Shoppers can order catalog results by newest arrival or ascending and descending price.

features.name: Product Details
features.description: Shoppers can view product descriptions, image galleries, prices, availability, attributes, delivery information, and related products.

features.name: Variant Selection
features.description: Shoppers can choose product options to select a purchasable, in-stock variant whose identifier is reflected in the URL.

features.name: Shopping Cart
features.description: Shoppers can add products to a persistent cart, inspect totals, change quantities, and remove line items.

features.name: Promotion Codes
features.description: Shoppers can apply and remove promotion codes from their cart before purchase.

features.name: Gift Cards
features.description: Shoppers can apply and remove gift-card codes, including completing checkout when a gift card covers the full total.

features.name: Regional Shopping
features.description: Shoppers can select a shipping country while the storefront automatically resolves the matching sales region, currency, pricing, and cart.

features.name: Language Selection
features.description: Shoppers can choose from backend-provided locales and refresh the storefront in the selected language context.

features.name: Multi-Step Checkout
features.description: Shoppers can progress through address, delivery, payment, review, and order-placement steps.

features.name: Saved Checkout Addresses
features.description: Signed-in shoppers can select an existing account address while entering checkout details.

features.name: Shipping Method Selection
features.description: Shoppers can compare available shipping options and select one for the current cart.

features.name: Payment Method Selection
features.description: Shoppers can choose an available payment provider and enter the provider-specific payment details needed for checkout.

features.name: Stripe Payments
features.description: Shoppers can pay through Stripe and return from off-site authorization to retry or complete their order securely.

features.name: Adyen Payments
features.description: Shoppers can submit Adyen payments, including redirect-based bank authentication returns.

features.name: Order Placement
features.description: Shoppers can submit a reviewed cart as an order and reach an order-confirmation page.

features.name: Customer Accounts
features.description: Customers can create verified accounts, sign in, inspect an account dashboard, and sign out.

features.name: Email Verification
features.description: New customers receive a verification flow and can confirm their email before signing in.

features.name: Profile Management
features.description: Customers can update stored personal information such as their name, phone number, and billing address.

features.name: Address Book
features.description: Customers can add, edit, and delete reusable delivery addresses in their account.

features.name: Order History
features.description: Customers can browse prior orders and open detailed views of their items, payment, shipping, and totals.

features.name: Order Transfers
features.description: Customers can request that an existing order be connected to their account, while recipients can accept or decline the transfer.

features.name: Store Policies
features.description: Shoppers can view region-specific shipping, returns, privacy, and terms information exposed by the storefront.

features.name: Direct Checkout Links
features.description: A caller can open a buy permalink containing variant IDs and quantities to create a cart and redirect directly into checkout.

features.name: Agent Commerce API
features.description: Automated clients can discover and operate a versioned commerce API covering catalogs, carts, and checkout sessions.

features.name: Agent Catalog Access
features.description: Automated clients can search the catalog or look up exact products through UCP endpoints.

features.name: Agent Cart Management
features.description: Automated clients can create, retrieve, update, or cancel carts through the UCP API.

features.name: Agent Checkout Sessions
features.description: Automated clients can create, inspect, update, complete, or cancel checkout sessions through the UCP API.

features.name: Commerce MCP Endpoint
features.description: MCP-compatible agents can invoke the commerce operations through a JSON-RPC endpoint.

features.name: Price Range Filtering
features.description: Shoppers can restrict catalog results to a selected minimum and maximum price.

features.name: Sale Product Filtering
features.description: Shoppers can limit catalog results to products whose current price is discounted.

features.name: Stock Availability
features.description: Product pages show whether the selected variant is in stock or unavailable.

features.name: Product Specifications
features.description: Product pages expose material, origin, type, weight, and dimensions in an expandable information section.

features.name: Related Product Recommendations
features.description: Product pages recommend other products sharing the current product's collection or tags.

features.name: Free Shipping Progress
features.description: The cart displays how much more must be purchased to unlock a conditional free-shipping rate.

features.name: Markdown Product Feeds
features.description: API callers and agents can request a Markdown representation of a product containing purchasable variant details.

features.name: LLM Store Guide
features.description: The storefront serves an llms.txt guide describing its shopping URLs, countries, catalog links, policies, and agent interfaces.
